purpose: Compare the same evidence implementation across an internal call and a future MCP boundary without attributing packaging effects to source understanding.

minimum_tool.registry: Operator-owned allowlist, frozen before model input; no model-provided roots, URLs, shell commands or credentials.
minimum_tool.source_effects: Read registered files only; never import or execute inspected source.
minimum_tool.audit_effects: Write exclusive request, result and receipt records to an operator-owned journal. Source-read-only does not imply zero filesystem side effects.
minimum_tool.evidence_authority: Exact physical quotation only; syntax extraction does not verify runtime bindings, dependency semantics, permission or publication approval.
minimum_tool.new_bridge_requirement: Bind an authorized job to a durable global budget and deadline. A new helper instance per wire request must not reset the job budget.

application_result_mapping_proposal.wire_treatment: Successful structured result with exact evidence and false authority flags.
Successful structured result with an explicit missing-evidence reason; no invented quotation.
Preserve verified original result identity and duplicate status; do not rerun extraction.
Application refusal with no quotation; retain a bounded reason and audit identity.
Unknown completion, no automatic retry; owner/operator reconciliation is required.
Do not migrate or replay silently; select an explicitly reviewed new request identity.

mapping_limit: These are proposed application conventions, not claims that MCP mandates these names or that every refusal is a JSON-RPC error. Malformed protocol requests and tool execution errors require separate conformance tests.

freeze_before_execution: Model digest, prompt and context budget
Tool budget, timeout and completion reconciliation policy
Transport revision, implementation and client version
arms: Future MCP wrapper using the identical helper implementation
frozen_comparison.paired_control: Same registered source, selector, quotation and downstream model prompt where feasible. Record any unavoidable envelope differences.
frozen_comparison.acceptance: Zero critical false removals, zero unauthorized source effects, zero silent retries of unknown completion; factual improvement must be measured against the same frozen reference, not inferred from protocol compliance.
frozen_comparison.holdout: Use a new unexposed family after development; language variants, helper files and related repositories remain in the same family. Current research fixtures are development data.
frozen_comparison.rollback: Omit the optional retrieval call and preserve all journals. Do not discard failed attempts or alter the ordinary Ruby route automatically.

owner_decisions_before_future_implementa: Specific MCP revision, SDK and compatible client; dependency and license review
Transport and process lifecycle; no new listening port by default
Authorized source roots, principal/job identity and audit destination
Durable global budgets, cancellation, late completion and restart semantics
Whether to package portable skills or a plugin and which client will load them
Whether any production prompt or tool routing should change after regressions pass
Publication, training use and remote artifact storage destinations
existing_experiment_outcome: Retrieval feasibility verified; improved generated architectural coverage was not demonstrated.
